description: This Java source file defines the CoapTransportService class, which implements the TbTransportService interface. It manages the initialization and shutdown of a CoAP server with specific resources related to the Thingsboard platform, including setting up API and efento resources, and handling OTA package resources.

classes.name: CoapTransportService
classes.description: Service class managing CoAP transport, including server startup and shutdown, resource setup, and implementing TbTransportService interface.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the CoAP server, adds resources, and starts the transport.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Stops the CoAP transport and logs the shutdown.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the transport, as defined in DataConstants.
